Subject: RE: Onboarding: Console + API walkthrough — time change request

Hi Priyom,

Quick note — thanks again for the draft agenda. We need to shift the session away from the afternoon window on July 22 because a core security lead will be unavailable (internal review pushed from the morning). Would it be possible to run an evening bridge instead (US West friendly) so our APAC folks can also join?

We have two constraints: 1) our sandbox service account needs to be reissued (previous key expired), and 2) we may add a second attendee from engineering who needs workspace-level access. Can you confirm whether the sandbox token rotation can be done ahead of the session or whether we should plan for a short preflight call?

If evenings work, propose 2026-07-22 01:00 UTC (6pm PT) or 2026-07-22 02:30 UTC (7:30pm PT). We prefer the earlier slot if you have the bandwidth.

Thanks — CC'd platform@finhive.co who will handle access details.

— Carla

Hi Carla — thanks for the heads up. Evening bridge is fine — we can support either slot but prefer the 01:00 UTC (6pm PT) to keep the session compact.

Regarding sandbox access: we can rotate the service token in advance, but we'll need a named owner on your side for the new credential (audit reasons). If platform@finhive.co can confirm the person, Camila will run the rotation today and attach the new token to a temporary role that expires after the session.

Proposed plan: 
- Today (15 Jul): Camila performs token rotation and posts the temporary credential to a secure Doc (link below)
- 21 Jul: 30-minute preflight (optional) for engineering attendee to validate SSH/API connectivity
- 22 Jul 01:00 UTC: Main walkthrough (Console + API, focused debugging and workspace setup)

I attached the current enablement runbook and a short checklist — Ben will own the evening bridge agenda and Jordan will be the ops fallback.

Are there any other stakeholders we should loop in (legal/security)?

Best,
Priyom

- Confirm workspace role bindings for the new attendee
